name: XCOPA
description: XCOPA is a multilingual dataset for causal commonsense reasoning covering 11 typologically diverse languages. It evaluates models' ability to reason about causes and effects in everyday situations across languages.
reputation: A well-known multilingual commonsense reasoning benchmark widely used for cross-lingual evaluation and often included in multilingual NLP leaderboards.
notes: Addresses cross-lingual transfer challenges and resource-lean language adaptation.
